items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: I said, go ahead Laffy and play something... I said, alright, what you looking at? You think I can't play nothing?

ctx.x: Well, Bob, wait until Saturday night.

My best night. And he stayed right around the corner. Just right around the corner walk. He had been over the Warriors, I guess, all day. You know, he comes standing in there, quarter to nine. Laffy and said, I'm looking at him. Bat said, I ought to be the MG. Bat. Yeah, yeah. Bat said, I ought to be the MG tonight. Yeah. So he come in there. I wouldn't say nothing. He's looking for all the guys. I'm looking at him. I'm looking at him. I'm looking at him. I'm looking at him. Bat said, I ought to be the MG…
That's hard to execute that fighting. I'm telling you. That's low on in that temple like that, see.
